About sound testing
Start with low system volume and use the phone speaker. Stop if you hear a high tone or feel discomfort. High frequencies may be audible or produce audible artifacts on some devices.
Goodput counts verified payload data acknowledged through sound, including waiting and retries. The scan is limited by both devices’ sample rates; their speakers and microphones may not support every band.
Results stay in this browser. Audio and transferred data are not uploaded. Switching apps or locking the screen stops audio.
